description: Shared vectors for the reasoning marker: cvc-core/src/reasoning.rs read() and cvc-reviewer/src/lib/reasoningMarker.ts readReasoning() must agree on each. Generated by cvc-reviewer/scripts/reasoning-marker-vectors.mjs; do not edit by hand. For each vector, read(id, text) is "provider_summary" with the body after the marker, or "unverified", whose body is the whole text (what ReasoningView::body() returns). A withheld note is not a marker: it reads "unverified"; readers that label it "Withheld" do so on top of read().
